title: Retail Installment Contracts Calendar Note: Payoffs Posted at the End of the Week
content:
A borrower payoff of a contract under Retail Installment Contracts posted at the end of the week carries weekend-receipt days that take its good-through date to the following Monday:

| Payoff posted on | Weekend-receipt days |
|---|---|
| Friday | **3** |
| Saturday | **2** |
| Sunday | **1** |
| Monday to Thursday | none |

**The day of the week.** It is found as the whole days since Monday 5 January 2026 (2026-01-05), modulo seven: remainder 0 Monday, 1 Tuesday, 2 Wednesday, 3 Thursday, 4 Friday, 5 Saturday, 6 Sunday.

**Worked dates.** 17 January 2026 is 12 days after 5 January 2026, remainder 5: a Saturday, 2 days. 23 January 2026 is 18 days after, remainder 4: a Friday, 3 days. 21 January 2026 is 16 days after, remainder 2: a Wednesday, none.
